properties.description: Doorway to bakery > 90 cm. No steps or doorway lip to manuever over. Washroom doorway is 90 cm. Washroom contains handrails by toilet and wheelchair-accessible hand basin. #DalOT #StudentProject

description.en: Accessible parking spot can be used to access nearby businesses.

properties.description: Entrance has no steps, washroom is big (6.5' by 5') #DalOT #StudentProject

There are two steps to entrance, both were over 7cm in height. Once inside, the bathroom was also not accessible as it was not large enough for a wheelchair to even enter it along with no grab rails and a non-accessible basin. #DalOT #StudentProject
#dalOT #studentproject

Washroom was narrow, no grab bars, no space under sink for wheelchair to fit. Floor plan is relatively open, a few booths with a step up that are not accessible as well as stool seating at a high bar. High counter for mixing coffee#DalOT #studentproject
#DalOT #StudentProject

properties.description: Suited with a sufficient wheel chair ramp. Door was not automated and may be difficult for some wheelchair users to open as it was a manual push door. Once inside, the bathroom was not accessible as the doorway was only 64cm wide. #DalOT #StudentProject

description.en: Wheelchair accessible, no power door for entry. Items on shelves are not too high, though certain items may be difficult to reach. No bathroom provided for customers

description.en: Power door entry with 34 inch wide door. The bathroom doorway is a little bit too narrow (approx. 30 inches) and there are no wall bars beside the toilet.
Wheelchair accessible. Bar counter is too high for someone sitting down. Employees will serve drinks to designated table when asked, however. Bathroom is spacious and accessible

Wheelchair accessible cafe. The outside deck is not accessible as it as a 5 inch step. The bathroom entry is accessible, the space inside the bathroom is very limited and manoeuvring may prove to be difficult

Entrance to store is accessible with automatic doors. The bathroom door has to be pushed open (does not stay open on its own). Bathroom meets accessibility requirements and is very spacious. #DalOT #Studentproject

The back entrance is accessible via a solid wood ramp. The width of the back door satisfies the requirements for accessibility. The bathroom is wide, spacious and there are grab rails beside the toilet. #DalOT #StudentProject

description.en: Wheelchair accessible entry and bathroom. The bar counter is too high for someone sitting down. The employee will, however, serve a wheelchair user at a table when asked.
